trans-unit.source:
The Adaptive Media app tailors media in your portal to the device consuming it. Since users often consume media on multiple devices that have different screen sizes and capabilities, you should make sure that your portal presents that media in a manner suitable for each device. For example, portal administrators can configure the Adaptive Media app to send high-res images to high-res devices, low-res images to low-res devices, and so on. This ensures that your users have the best possible experience when consuming media from your portal, regardless of the device they use.

Note that at this time, the Adaptive Media app only works with images in Documents and Media, Blogs, and Web Content.

Once installed, the Adaptive Media app appears in the Control Panel, under the Configuration menu.
trans-unit.target:
Adaptive Media 應用程式可在您的 Portal 中針對使用它的設備定制媒體。由於使用者經常在具有不同螢幕尺寸和功能的多台設備上使用媒體，因此應確保 Portal 以適合每種設備的方式呈現該媒體。例如， Portal 管理員可以將 Adaptive Media 應用程式配置為將高解析度圖檔發送到高解析度設備，將低解析度圖檔發送到低解析度設備，等等。這樣一來，當您的用戶流覽 Portal 中的媒體時，無論他們使用哪種設備，都能確保獲得最佳體驗。

請注意，目前，Adaptive Media 應用程式僅適用於文件與媒體、部落格以及網站內容中的圖檔。

安裝後，Adaptive Media 應用程式將出現在 "控制面板" 中的 "配置選單" 下。

Bean Portlet provides CDI "bean portlets" capability. It lets you register portlets using annotations such as @PortletConfiguration and its @Inject annotation obtains dependencies via Contexts and Dependency Injection (CDI). Bean portlets are a feature of the Portlet 3.0 Specification as defined by JSR 362.

The Bean Portlet modules install to LIFERAY_HOME/osgi/modules/static.
trans-unit.target:
Bean Portlet 提供 CDI "bean portlet" 功能。借助此功能，您可以使用 @PortletConfiguration 之類的注解註冊 portlet，其 @Inject 注解通過上下文和依賴項注入 (CDI) 獲得依賴項。Bean Portlet 是 JSR 362 定義的 Portlet 3.0 規範的一項功能。

Bean Portlet 模組安裝到 LIFERAY_HOME/osgi/modules/static 中。

After installing this app, you can access the Bookmarks widget from the Widgets menu.

書籤應用程式添加了可用於列出和組織書籤 Widget。通過將書籤 Widget 放置在網站頁面上，管理員可以為整個社區策劃令使用者感興趣的書簽。Widget 可以將內部 Portal 頁面以及外部網址添加為書籤。

trans-unit.source:
With Liferay Data Engine, use high level APIs to quickly assemble scalable, flexible business applications. Without writing persistence code or complex custom business logic, you can call the Data Engine APIs to create an entire application.

The Data Definition API is at the core of the Data Engine. It lets you:
* Define the fields of the data definition.
* Execute CRUD operations on Data Definitions.
* Define validation rules for data definition elements.

The Data Record Collection API collects the data records backed by the data definition.
* Execute CRUD operations on Data Record Collections and their Data Records.

The Data Layouts API lets you add and edit data layouts to style the Data Definition's form.

This kind of flexible app builder helps modern businesses remain competitive. Customized digital solutions do not build themselves, but the Data Engine's APIs make it painless to rapidly create new applications.
trans-unit.target:
借助 Liferay Data Engine，可使用高級 API 快速組裝可擴展的靈活業務應用程式。 無需編寫持久性代碼或複雜的自定義業務邏輯，您就可以調用 Data Engine API 來創建整個應用程式。

數據定義 API 是 Data Engine 的核心。 它使您可以：
*定義數據定義的欄位。
*對數據定義執行CRUD操作。
*定義數據定義元素的驗證規則。

數據記錄收集 API 收集由數據定義支持的數據記錄。
*對數據記錄集合及其數據記錄執行CRUD操作。

數據佈局 API 允許您添加和編輯數據 佈局以對數據定義的表單進行樣式設置。

這種靈活的應用構建器可幫助現代企業保持競爭力。 定制的數字解決方案無法自行構建，但是 Data Engine 的 API 使快速創建新應用程式變得輕鬆自如。

trans-unit.source: The Liferay Plugin for Google Drive™ lets users create shortcuts to Google Drive™ files in their Documents and Media repositories. These documents can be viewed and managed from Documents and Media. Once deployed, you can configure this app from the Control Panel.
trans-unit.target: 適用於 Google Drive™ 的 Liferay 插件程式允許用戶在文件與媒體儲存庫中創建 Google Drive™ 檔的快捷方式。可以從 "文件與媒體" 查看和管理這些文檔。部署後，您可以從 "控制面板" 配置此應用程式。

trans-unit.source:
The Liferay REST APIs app exposes a new breed of RESTful APIs that interact with Liferay services. These APIs let developers consume Liferay services in a straightforward and flexible way. For example, developers can consume portal resources like documents, blogs, or structured content via fully RESTful APIs that support several response formats like JSON or XML.

This app has no visual component in the portal. After installing it, you can begin accessing the APIs in the corresponding URLs that you can check via http://[host]:[port]/o/api.
trans-unit.target:
Liferay REST APIs 應用程式公開了與 Liferay 服務交互的新型 RESTful API。 這些 API 使開發人員能夠以直接，靈活的方式使用 Liferay 服務。 例如，開發人員可以通過支持多種響應格式（如JSON或XML）的完全 RESTful API 來使用 Portal 網站資源，如文檔，部落格或結構化內容。

此應用程式在 Portal 中沒有可視元件。 安裝後，您可以開始通過相應的 URL 訪問 API，可以通過 http://[host]:[port]/o/api 檢查這些 URL。

trans-unit.source:
Liferay's Knowledge Base app provides a means for creating and organizing articles within a site. The knowledge base is perfect for creating and organizing information more formally than in a wiki. For example, it can be used to organize and display professional product documentation. The knowledge base lets you import article source files written in Markdown, so you can work on them offline before publishing. Its integration with GitHub allows you to give users access to contribute fixes or improvements to articles. It is easy to set up the knowledge base with a workflow that requires articles to be approved before they are published. Additionally, it allows administrators to create article templates. Templates can be used to ensure that certain kinds of articles possess a common structure and include certain kinds of information. Knowledge base articles can be categorized to make them easy to find. They can also be organized hierarchically to form complete books or guides. There are multiple portlets included in this app.

This app will appear in your Application menu and Site Administration once installed.
trans-unit.target:
Liferay 的知識庫應用程序提供了一種在網站內創建和組織文章的方法。知識庫是比 Wiki 更正式地創建和組織信息的理想選擇。例如，它可以用於組織和顯示專業產品文檔。知識庫使您可以導入以 Markdown 編寫的文章源文件，因此可以在發布前設定使用它們。它與 GitHub 的集成使您可以為用戶提供對文章的修正或改進的訪問權限。使用需要在文章發表之前對其進行批准的工作流程來建立知識庫很容易。此外，它允許管理員創建文章範本。範本可用於確保某些種類的文章具有共同的結構並包含某些種類的信息。可以對知識庫文章進行分類，以使其易於查找。它們也可以按層次進行組織，以形成完整的書籍或指南。此應用程序中包含多個 portlet。

安裝後，該應用程序將出現在應用程式選單和站台管理中。

trans-unit.source: Liferay Marketplace is an integral part of the Liferay platform experience for all users. Enterprise subscribers also have exclusive access to Liferay Subscription Apps through the Liferay Marketplace. Log in with your Liferay account to browse hundreds of apps to help you build your business or technical solution.
trans-unit.target: Liferay Marketplace 對於所有用戶來說都是 Liferay 平台體驗不可或缺的一部分。 企業訂閱者還可以通過 Liferay 市場獨家訪問 Liferay 訂閱應用程序。 使用 Liferay 帳戶登錄以瀏覽數百個應用程式，以幫助您構建業務或技術解決方案。

trans-unit.source: Liferay Plugin for OAuth 2.0 is an industry-standard authorization protocol. Users can seamlessly share select credentials from another website to log into yours. It works by authorizing password-less access to portions of user-owned resources (such as an email address, a user profile picture, or something else from your account) and other permissioned resources.
trans-unit.target: 用於 OAuth 2.0 的 Liferay 插件是工業標準的授權協議。用戶可以無縫共享其他網站上的選定 credentials 以登錄到您的網站。 它通過授權無密碼訪問部分用戶擁有的資源（例如電子郵件地址，用戶個人資料圖片或您帳戶中的其他內容）和其他允許的資源而起作用。
trans-unit.note:
@liferay-is There are errors in the source text. I guess "Liferay Plugin for" should be removed as the plugin is not protocol. Also, "share select credentials" is grammatically incorrect. I guess "share" is unnecessary.
https://web.liferay.com/ja/marketplace/-/mp/application/109572023

@Taishiro-Alconost I guess "select" means "specific" here, it's not a verb. And "Liferay Plugin for OAuth 2.0" is an application name, so it seems correct. But let's wait for an official reply from @liferay-is.

@Taishiro-Alconost sorry for the delay getting back to you. This string has a lot to it, and therefore, a lot of places for unintentional interpretations.
We actually have a plugin naming standard wherein any 3rd party integrations must be dealt with in a particular way. In this case, for an app, we call it "Liferay Plugin *for* {3rd_party_service}". We also have "Liferay Connector for..." and "Translator using..." to deal with that 3rd party relationship and to show a purely code integration relationship. So the name chosen in this string follows one of our naming conventions.
With "seamlessly share *select* credentials" - I'd say this can come down to preference, and @rafag noted the sense. To indicate 'a subset' or 'certain grouping' , I've seen some people say "select" and others say "selected" - there's definitely some wiggle room, and I think either can work. The idea it's trying to convey is that not only can a User *share* credentials, but they can *choose which ones* they would like to share.
I'm not adamant on each word being accounted for exactly this way in Japanese, so I'm sure you know of a better way to capture the sense I described above in Japanese, and I trust you'll make the best judgment. :)

The customer would like to have a consistent translation for "Password". Currently, it is either "Kennwort" or "Passwort". "Kennwort" seems to be used in most places, so we should change every occurrence to that.

trans-unit.source: Leverage Liferay Reports's easy to use and intuitive UI for creating and scheduling report generation runs. The Liferay Reports app packages a reporting engine with Jasper Reports, an excellent implementation, giving you out-of-the-box ability to upload report definitions (designed in a report designer) into Reports Admin, and run them from the Definitions tab. Generate reports manually or schedule report generation runs. Export reports to HTML, CSV, XLS, PDF, and more. Reports can be viewed in the Reports Admin application in the Control Panel, or on a page with the Reports Display application, and can also be delivered via email.
trans-unit.target: 利用 Liferay Reports 的易於使用和直觀的 UI 來創建和安排報告生成運行。 Liferay Reports 應用程式將報表引擎與 Jasper Reports 打包在一起，Jasper Reports 是一個出色的實現，使您可以立即使用的功能將報告定義（在報告設計器中設計）上傳到 Reports Admin 中，然後從 "定義" 選項頁籤去執行它們。 手動生成報表或安排報表生成運行。 將報表導出為 HTML、CSV、XLS、PDF 等。 可以在 "控制面板" 的 "Reports Admin" 應用程式中，或在 "Reports Display" 應用程式的頁面上查看報表，也可以通過電子郵件發送報表。
trans-unit.note: @liferay-is I guess "packages" is used in the sense of "implements". Is my understanding correct?

trans-unit.source:
Liferay Digital Enterprise provides an implementation of a JSR-94 compliant rules engine as a web app, based on the popular open source Drools project. A rules engine provides a means to separate the rules or logic of an application from the remaining code. This allows for a more declarative style of programming where the rules define what is happening, without describing how it is happening. This makes it much easier to read than nested 'if-else' blocks of code. It is also easier to make changes without introducing bugs in your code. The rules are also written in a language that is easier for non-developers to understand. This makes it easier for business users to validate and even modify the rules without having to involve developers.

This app installs as a Liferay service.
trans-unit.target:
Liferay Digital Enterprise 以流行的開源 Drools 項目為基礎，提供了一個符合 JSR-94 的規則引擎作為 Web 應用程式的實現。 規則引擎提供了一種將應用程式的規則或邏輯與其餘代碼分開的方法。 這允許一種更具聲明性的編程風格，其中規則定義了正在發生的事情，而沒有描述它是如何發生的。 這比嵌套的 "if-else" 代碼塊更容易閱讀。 在不引入代碼錯誤的情況下進行更改也更加容易。規則還以非開發人員更易於理解的語言編寫。 這使業務用戶更容易驗證甚至修改規則，而無需開發人員參與。

此應用程式作為 Liferay 服務安裝。

trans-unit.source:
The ${liferay.releng.app.title.prefix} Enterprise Search Cross-Cluster Replication app lets you perform read operations from a local cluster that has been configured to replicate, or follow, the indices of a remote cluster. The local cluster containing the replicated indices must be configured manually before this app can execute requests against it. You can find more information about Cross-Cluster Replication at https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/7.9/xpack-ccr.html.
To learn about compatibility, see the compatibility matrix: https://help.liferay.com/hc/en-us/articles/360016511651#Liferay-Enterprise-Search.
trans-unit.target:
使用 ${liferay.releng.app.title.prefix} nterprise Search Cross-Cluster Replication 應用程式，您可以從已配置為複製或遵循遠程叢集索引的本地叢集中執行讀取操作。 在此應用可以對其執行請求之前，必須手動配置包含複製索引的本地叢集。 您可以在 https://www.elastic.co/guide/zh-cn/elasticsearch/reference/7.9/xpack-ccr.html 上找到有關跨叢集複製的更多信息。
要了解兼容性，請參閱兼容性列表 ：https://help.liferay.com/hc/en-us/articles/360016511651#Liferay-Enterprise-Search。

trans-unit.source:
The ${liferay.releng.app.title.prefix} Enterprise Search Monitoring app monitors your Elasticsearch cluster in real time by providing a view of the Kibana Monitoring UI through a Liferay DXP instance.
According to Elastic's website, "From the Kibana Monitoring UI, you can spot issues at a glance and delve into the system behavior over time to diagnose operational issues."
You must install Kibana before using the ${liferay.releng.app.title.prefix} Enterprise Search Monitoring plugin. You can find more information about Monitoring Elasticsearch at https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/kibana/current/xpack-monitoring.html.
To learn about compatibility, see the compatibility matrix: https://help.liferay.com/hc/en-us/articles/360016511651#Liferay-Enterprise-Search.
trans-unit.target:
${liferay.releng.app.title.prefix} Enterprise Search Monitoring 應用程式通過 Liferay DXP 實例提供 Kibana 監視 UI 的視圖，從而實時監視您的Elasticsearch 叢集。
根據 Elastic 的網站，"來自 在Kibana 監視 UI中，您可以一目了然地發現問題，並隨著時間的推移深入研究系統行為，以診斷操作問題。"
在使用 ${liferay.releng.app.title.prefix} 企業版之前，您必須安裝 Kibana 搜索監控插件。 您可以在 https://www.elastic.co/guide/zh-cn/kibana/current/xpack-monitoring.html 上找到有關 Monitoring Elasticsearch 的更多資訊。
要了解兼容性，請參閱兼容性列表：https://help.liferay.com/hc/zh-cn/articles/360016511651#Liferay-Enterprise-Search。

trans-unit.source:
${liferay.releng.app.title.prefix} Connector to Elasticsearch 7 connects Liferay Portal or Liferay DXP to Elasticsearch 7.9 search engines.
For detailed compatibility information, see the Search Engine Compatibility Matrix: https://help.liferay.com/hc/en-us/articles/360016511651.
trans-unit.target:
${liferay.releng.app.title.prefix} 到 Elasticsearch 7 的連接器將 Liferay Portal 或 Liferay DXP 連接到 Elasticsearch 7.9+ 搜尋引擎。
有關詳細的兼容性資訊，請參閱搜索引擎兼容性列表：https://help.liferay.com/hc/zh-cn/articles/360016511651 。

trans-unit.source:
The ${liferay.releng.app.title.prefix} Enterprise Search Learning to Rank app exposes Liferay DXP search queries to re-scoring via the Elasticsearch Learning to Rank plugin. Install a plugin to Elasticsearch, install this application to Liferay DXP, mix in a bit of data science, and you can point Liferay search queries at a trained Learning to Rank model that you have uploaded to the Elasticsearch plugin. Your Liferay queries are re-scored by the AI-trained model to produce better search results for your Liferay DXP end users.
To learn about compatibility, see the compatibility matrix: https://help.liferay.com/hc/en-us/articles/360016511651#Liferay-Enterprise-Search.
trans-unit.target:
${liferay.releng.app.title.prefix} Enterprise Search Learning to Rank 應用程式通過 Elasticsearch 學習排名插件對 Liferay DXP 搜索查詢進行重新評分。 將插件安裝到 Elasticsearch，將此應用程式安裝到 Liferay DXP，混合使用一些數據科學，然後您可以將 Liferay 搜索查詢指向已上傳到Elasticsearch 插件的經過訓練的 "學習排名" 模型。 通過 AI 訓練的模型對您的 Liferay 查詢進行重新評分，以此為 Liferay DXP 最終用戶提供更好的搜索結果。
要了解兼容性，請參閱兼容性列表：https://help.liferay.com/hc/en-us/articles/360016511651＃Liferay-Enterprise-Search。

trans-unit.source:
This app integrates Liferay DXP with Apache Solr 8, the popular open source enterprise search platform from the Apache Lucene project. Solr includes powerful full-text search, hit highlighting, faceted search, dynamic clustering, database integration, rich document (e.g., Word, PDF) handling, and geospatial search. Solr is highly scalable, providing distributed search and index replication, and it powers the search and navigation features of many of the world's largest internet sites. The installation of this app requires specific configurations listed in the Official Documentation. On installing, enabling, and configuring this app, Liferay DXP communicates with a remotely deployed Solr 8 server for indexing and searching.
For detailed compatibility information, including the compatible Solr 8 minor versions and required Liferay DXP patch levels, see the Search Engine Compatibility Matrix: https://help.liferay.com/hc/en-us/articles/360016511651.
trans-unit.target:
該應用程式與 Apache Solr 8 集成，Apache Solr 8 是來自 Apache Lucene 專案的流行的開源企業搜尋平台。 它的主要功能包括強大的全文檢索、突出顯示的內容、多面向搜尋、動態叢集、數據庫整合、豐富的文檔（例如Word，PDF）處理和地理空間搜尋。 Solr 具有高度可伸縮性，可提供分佈式搜索和索引複製，並為許多世界上最大的互聯網站點的搜索和導航功能提供支持。 此應用的安裝需要官方文檔中列出的特定配置。 安裝並啟用此應用程式後，Liferay Portal 和 Liferay DXP 將與遠端部署的 Solr 服務器通信以進行索引和搜索。
有關詳細的兼容性信息，請參閱搜尋引擎兼容性列表：https://help.liferay.com / hc / zh-CN / articles / 360016511651。

trans-unit.source: The Liferay Push app exposes a framework that lets developers send push notifications from Liferay to native Android and iOS apps. By leveraging Liferay Push, you can ensure that your users know about the latest information in your Liferay instance, no matter where they are. Push also functions seamlessly with Liferay Screens. Installing the Liferay Push app automatically exposes its push framework. This app also contains a Control Panel portlet that you can use to send test push notifications.
trans-unit.target: Liferay Push 應用程式公開了一個框架，該框架使開發人員可以將Liferay 的推送通知發送到本機 Android 和 iOS 應用程式。 通過使用Liferay Push，您可以確保用戶無論在何處都可以了解 Liferay 實例中的最新資訊。 推送還可以與 Liferay 屏幕無縫配合。 安裝 Liferay Push 應用程序會自動公開其推送框架。 該應用程式還包含一個控制面板Portlet，可用於發送測試推送通知。

trans-unit.source:
Security Assertion Markup Language 2.0 (SAML 2.0) is a version of the SAML OASIS standard for exchanging authentication and authorization data between security domains. SAML 2.0 is an XML-based protocol that uses security tokens containing assertions to pass information about a principal (usually an end-user) between an identity provider and a web service. SAML 2.0 enables web-based authentication and authorization scenarios including single sign-on (SSO). This app enables Liferay to act as a SAML 2.0 Identity Provider (IdP) or Service Provider (SP). It is built on top of OpenSAML and uses the Java Keystore for providing certificates/credentials for security. Once this app is installed, additional configuration is required to adapt the app with your local SAML environment and configuration. Visit the Documentation link to learn more about SAML and its configuration options.

Supported SAML Providers: PingFederate, ADFS, Shibboleth, Siteminder, and OpenAM.
trans-unit.target:
安全聲明標記語言2.0（SAML 2.0）是 SAML OASIS 標準的一個版本，用於在安全域之間交換身份驗證和授權數據。 SAML 2.0 是基於 XML 的協議，它使用包含斷言的安全 tokens 在身份提供者和 Web 服務之間傳遞有關委託人（通常是最終用戶）的信息。 SAML 2.0 支持基於 Web 的身份驗證和授權方案，包括單點登錄（SSO）。 此應用程式使 Liferay 可以充當 SAML 2.0 身份提供程序（IdP）或服務提供程序（SP）。 它基於OpenSAML 構建，並使用 Java 密鑰庫提供安全性證書/憑證。 安裝此應用程式後，需要進行其他配置才能使該應用程式適合您的本地 SAM L環境和配置。 訪問文檔鏈接以了解有關 SAML 及其配置選項的更多資訊。

trans-unit.source:
The ${liferay.releng.app.title.prefix} Enterprise Search Experiences app includes a suite of features that unlock the full potential of Liferay's search framework for all Liferay users. The initial release introduces the "Search Blueprints" feature. With Blueprints, search administrators can

* Tweak Liferay's default search behavior, or completely override it
* Provide context-aware search results based on the search user's attributes

Search Blueprints enables search administrators to refine Liferay's default search behavior or build completely custom search algorithms using a no-code visual query builder. Each Blueprint is composed of multiple building blocks called "Elements"; each Element influences the search query in some way. For example, compose a Blueprint by adding one Element that hides content tagged "expired", another that ignores comments, and another that includes fields normally ignored by the default search algorithm.

You can configure each Element using familiar UI controls like input fields, dropdown lists, and date pickers. Several convenient elements are included with the Blueprints app (e.g., Elements for boosting results by geolocation, content freshness, time-based conditional boosts, etc.). In addition, you can create new Elements to harness the full capabilities of Liferay's search framework.

Search Blueprints are context-aware. You can provide personalized search results based on the user's profile, roles, location, local time, segment, etc. For example, a Blueprint can boost manufacturing industry case studies based on the user's email address or job title.

Each search page can use a different Blueprint, allowing unique search algorithms for different search use cases like intranets, commerce, and marketing sites.
trans-unit.target:
${liferay.releng.app.title.prefix} Enterprise Search Experiences 應用程式套件為非開發人員釋放了 Liferay 搜尋框架的全部功能。此版本引入了 "搜尋藍圖" 應用程式，使搜尋管理員能夠調整 Liferay 的預設搜尋行為或使用無代碼可視化查詢構建器，構建完全自定義的搜尋算法。每個藍圖由多個 "元素" 組成，每個元素以某種方式影響搜尋查詢。例如，一個元素可以隱藏標籤為 "過期" 的內容，另一個元素可以忽略搜尋評論，而另一個元素可以包含在預設搜尋演算法中通常被忽略的欄位。每個元素都可以使用熟悉的 UI 控件（如輸入欄位、下拉列表和日期選擇器）進行配置。 OOTB 中有幾個元素可用，例如用於通過地理位置、內容新鮮度、基於時間的條件提升等來提升結果的元素。高級用戶可以創建自己的元素來利用 Liferay 搜尋框架的全部功能。

藍圖還具有上下文感知能力，允許根據使用者的個人資料、角色、位置、當地時間、分眾市場等獲得個人化的搜尋結果。例如，藍圖可以根據使用者的電子郵件地址或職位來促進製造業案例研究。每個搜尋頁面都可以與不同的藍圖相關聯，從而為不同的搜尋使用案例（如 Intranet、電商和營銷網站）提供獨特的搜尋演算法。

trans-unit.source:
The Liferay REST Connector for SharePoint lets users interact with files in SharePoint libraries from within a Liferay Documents and Media library. This app makes available in the Documents and Media Library a SharePoint repository type for mounting SharePoint libraries. Within such a repository, users can view, add, modify, and move files and folders. The app propagates actions performed in the SharePoint library to the SharePoint repository in the Liferay Documents and Media Library, and vice versa.

Here are some of the app's capabilities:

* Reading/writing documents and folders
* Document check-in, check-out, and undo check-out
* Downloading documents
* Moving folders and documents within the repository
* Getting revision history
* Reverting to a revision

The Liferay REST Connector for SharePoint:

* Works with SharePoint 2016 and SharePoint Online
* Uses Azure ACS with OAuth 2 for SharePoint server authorization (you must therefore enable HTTPS support in your app server)

Connect your Liferay Digital Experience Platform with your SharePoint libraries today!

Important Change: The name of this app was recently changed. Please visit https://help.liferay.com/hc/en-us/articles/360018233992 for further information about the installation procedure.
trans-unit.target:
Liferay REST Connector for SharePoint 使用戶可以從 Liferay 文件與媒體庫中與 SharePoint 庫中的文件進行交互。此應用程式在 "文件與媒體庫" 中提供了一種 SharePoint 庫類型，用於安裝 SharePoint 庫。在這樣的儲存庫中，用戶可以查看、添加、修改和移動文件和資料夾。該應用程式將在 SharePoint 庫中執行的操作傳播到 Liferay 文件與媒體庫中的 SharePoint 儲存庫，反之亦然。

以下是該應用程式的一些功能：

*讀取/寫入文件和資料夾
*檔案簽入、簽出和撤回
*下載文件
*在儲存庫中移動資料夾和文件
*獲取修訂歷史記錄
*恢復為修訂版本

用於 SharePoint的 Liferay REST 連接器：

*與 SharePoint 2016 和 SharePoint Online 一起使用
*使用 Azure ACS 使用 OAuth 2 進行 SharePoint 服務器授權（因此必須在應用服務器中啟用 HTTPS 支持）

將 Liferay Digital Experience Platform 與 SharePoint 庫立即連接！

重要更改：該應用程式的名稱最近已更改。請訪問 https://help.liferay.com/hc/en-us/articles/360018233992 了解有關安裝過程的更多資訊。
